## 2024-05-15 - [XSS via raw SVG in dangerouslySetInnerHTML]
**Vulnerability:** A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found in `MarkdownMessage.tsx` where un-sanitized SVG content was directly rendered into the DOM using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
**Learning:** `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` will execute embedded malicious scripts (e.g., `<script>alert(1)</script>`) within the SVG content if the content is from an untrusted source or generated by an LLM without proper sanitization. The internal DOM sanitization utility explicitly strips `<svg>` tags.
**Prevention:** To safely render user-supplied or LLM-generated SVGs, sandbox them using an `<img>` tag with a Data URI (e.g., `<img src={\`data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(text)}\`} />`). This forces the browser to treat the content strictly as an image, preventing script execution without requiring complex custom sanitization or new dependencies.
